## Abstract And Keyword Optimization

Suggest changes that improve fit without distorting the manuscript:

- title framing
- abstract emphasis
- keywords to add/remove
- methods clarity
- contribution statement
- international relevance or field relevance

## Verification Checklist

Before submission, verify:

- current aims and scope
- article type accepted
- word limit and formatting
- APC and waiver policy
- indexing status
- ethics/data requirements
- submission system status
- special issue deadlines if relevant
